info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-Create Creditcard Applications Activate-v5-spec
info.description: The Activate Credit Card Applications API facilitates the batch activation of credit card applications. This endpoint allows financial institutions and service providers to efficiently manage large volumes of activation requests for credit card applications in a streamlined manner. Typically utilized by banking systems and fintech platforms, this API ensures that applicants receive timely updates regarding their application status. By automating the activation process, organizations can enhance customer experience and operational efficiency.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to activate an application by sending a request with the necessary parameters. Make sure to provide the correct application ID to successfully activate the intended application.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the necessary information to activate an application. Please ensure all required fields are accurately filled before submission.
